title: Evaluating the Efficacy of Application Costs for Managing Congestion in Online Matching Markets
authors: Ni Huang; Gordon Burtch; Pei-yu Chen; Ao Huang
eligible_reason: Not a staggered design and no data shipped. The application-cost change is a single platform-wide system change (SystemChange) at one date. Worker-month analysis (Tables 5-7, Worker-Month_Level_Analysis.Rmd) runs fect(y ~ SystemChange_Treat + ln_NumRatings + ln_RatingValence + ln_Experience + ln_Tenure, index = c(worker_id, relative_month), method fe/ife/mc): a treated-vs-comparison worker group around one common change, indexed by month relative to it, with time-varying worker controls in every column (fect is not an admitted estimator in any case). Project-level analysis (Tables 8-11, Project-Level_Analysis.do) regresses outcomes on i.SystemChange##c.Duration (or ##c.Concentration_Demeaned) with employer and category FE and no calendar-time FE, plus project controls: continuous interaction, no time FE.
design_notes: Online labour market that imposed application (bid) costs on workers. Worker-month panel (final_df.csv, not shipped) with Treat x SystemChange; project-level cross-section of projects (final_df_project.csv, not shipped) before and after the change. Article text not available; the single change date is inferred from the code (SystemChange enters as a platform-level indicator and project regressions have no time FE; the worker panel is indexed by relative_month).
estimators_reported: fect counterfactual estimators (fe, ife, mc) with time-varying controls
OLS with employer and category FE, SystemChange x continuous moderator
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One platform-wide system change; cannot be verified from data (not shipped).
modern_estimators_named: fect (Liu-Wang-Xu counterfactual estimators; not an admitted estimator)
data_files_note: Readme.pdf: 'The dataset used in the study is proprietary.' Only Project-Level_Analysis.do and Worker-Month_Level_Analysis.Rmd are shipped.
software_notes: R (fixest, fect) for worker-month tables; Stata reghdfe for project-level tables.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README, code, OpenAlex abstract). Common-date platform policy change; no data.
